name: exchange-link
description: Kurdish currency exchange converter hosted on Cloudflare Pages and Workers

scripts.deploy: node build-dist.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=exchange-link --branch=main
scripts.push: git add . && git commit -m "Update site" && git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main
scripts.all: npm run deploy && npm run push
